reviewer.name: Codex independent Jiuwudaishi 005 Confucius chronology repair reviewer

summary: Accepted after independent full-source, sealed-replay, scope, and source-ownership review. The Kaiping 4 proposal records the construction and funding of a Wenxuan King temple, but it contains neither Confucius's personal name nor any birth or death date. Removing the imported BC 551–479 personal-attestation interval and replacing its mirrored active-date hint with a source-specific research hold is therefore necessary and minimal. The temple record itself remains in the canonical source and candidate extraction.
